power_state_plan.drawing_assumption: Single USB-C5V only. VBUS_RAW -> eFuse -> V5_SYS. AON is exclusively CC/supervisor logic, not Hub/ESP/display. Main enabled only by CC1.5A/3A. V3V3_D and V3V3_HUB are separate rails with a coordinated digital operating policy.

rail_contract.V3V3_AON: CC detection, supervisor and low-power hardware logic only
rail_contract.V3V3_D: ESP, both CH343 cores, MCP23017, control-side translators and VBUS sense buffer
rail_contract.V3V3_HUB: Dedicated TPS7A2033 from V5_SYS: CH334 pins13/20/21 and TS3USB221A VCC10
rail_contract.V3V3_USB: XU USB PHY, independent from Hub rail
rail_contract.V3V3_ADC_DIG: ADC digital and ADC-side I2C/audio/enable buffers
rail_contract.V3V3_DAC_DIG: DAC digital and DAC-side I2C/audio/enable buffers; keep distinct from V3V3_DAC_CLK/L/R
rail_contract.V5P_AFE: PGA positive rail and its translator B supply
rail_contract.V5N_AFE: PGA negative rail; also required for PGA_IO_READY

states.state: Detached, Default advertisement, or main disabled
requirements: Only permitted AON detection remains powered when USB present; Hub/ESP/bridges/XU main rails are off. No audio enumeration in this profile.
Upstream USB switch and VBUS buffer provide specified power-off protection. No external DC source exists.
All relay coils off; K1 phantom disconnected; K3 and K4 physically muted.
Software input current upper bound<=1.0A. Digital enumeration, control and USB loopback only.
PGA/ESS analog/HP/phantom off; RF disabled and low display backlight. No claim of complete analog audio.
ADC/DAC/PGA isolation disabled; CHIP_EN low; local I2C pull-ups remain on their own rails.

states.state: CC3A, analog permitted subject to actual budget
requirements: Software input upper bound<=2.2A after monitoring errors. Full analog is a design target, not a closed worst-case power budget.
Sequence separate ADC/DAC supplies; assert CHIP_EN and translator OE only after valid rails and required clocks.
Phantom remains locked off until surge-clamp/AFE-injection design is closed; HP switching remains subject to its power-off input-isolation requirement.
Hardware removes high-current ILIM branch immediately; firmware disables phantom and analog, lowers load, and returns to digital-only profile.
Exact mode/status crossing from AON to ESP must use Ioff or open-drain isolation and remains unassigned; do not directly wire powered AON outputs to dead ESP.
Retain a verified resume-capable Hub/ESP low-power path; disable phantom/AFE/codecs/backlight/RF as required.
Do not shut off all Hub power and claim host USB resume still works. Suspend current and protocol behavior are not validated.
Not an allowed normal state without additional Hub-port2 data isolation and UART0/control isolation. EN low or series22ohm alone is insufficient.

states.state: XU1.8V absent while CH343-B core remains powered
requirements: CH343 reverse-blocking evidence covers VIO-to-dead-core only; the opposite direction is not established. Coordinated shutdown or verified extra isolation is required.
TXU OE must stay low in brownout and relay unmute must remain inhibited.
